title: NDVI from a band pair — gain invariance of ratio indices

assertions.derivation: Lab grid contract: two-band (NIR, Red) stack, 16x16 at 0.001 deg.

KNOWN_ANSWER_MATRIX spectral family: ndvi(g*N, g*R) = ndvi(N,R) for g>0 — a pure gain cancels in the ratio. A per-band gain mismatch (scale 1e-4 vs 2e-4) breaks the cancellation: the index from metadata-calibrated values must equal the index from stored values per pixel. The declared offset must be zero for a gain-invariant index.

Closed form over the four quadrants (DN with scale 1e-4): index values -1/7 (water 480/640), 5/7 (veg 7200/1200), -1/13 (soil 2400/2800), 1/2 (sparse veg 4500/1500). mu=(-1/7+5/7-1/13+1/2)/4=181/728=0.248626374; population sigma=0.367174723. DNs up to 7200 are exact in Float32. Catches swapped band order (mean flips sign).
The scene has no invalid inputs; a correct product has zero NoData pixels.
